design.summary: New $0 stdlib step logreach.py (overlay -> logreach -> conclude): parse phase1 endpoint, prefix-exists then id-regexp ES queries per product profile (local/logreach), verdict seen/via_caller/not_seen/not_checkable; apply_reach joins _reach in both modes; reach_display shows not_seen as Low (scan: X) in render temp only; report_qa dsev; .severity never mutated.

implementation.summary: logreach.py (parser, id-regexp, EsSource with refusal, prefix-exists then exact ladder, verdicts incl via_caller, cache, keep-stored-on-unavailable); pipeline step overlay->logreach->conclude + rebuild/verify lists + config defaults; apply_reach/reach_display in report_common.sh; conclude + both summarizers; report_qa dsev E4/E7; QA rule text.

unit_test.result: All TASK-109 suites pass (logreach 73, pipeline_logreach 8, logreach_render 29, run_reports 67, report_qa 33, plan_reports 44 golden byte-identical, report_crosscheck 45 after F-109-T1 fix); shell.sh 505/0; full run: 3 pre-existing failures (ext_scan, track_hook, tracking_new_only; same at 461fa1a); bite checks on guards and severity mutation fail the tests.
